title: 16 miles, 80% in a river: Zion's Narrows #Shorts
description:
The Narrows from the top down: 16 miles one way from Chamberlain's Ranch, walls up to 1,000 feet, in places only 30 feet wide. Our own footage from the Virgin River.

Video: the channel's own footage from Zion (2021). Photos: NPS, HABS/HAER, NARA (Beaman/Hillers) and Wikimedia Commons (public domain, CC0).

▶ Full Zion documentary: https://youtu.be/ugASzW14E9s
